＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Kaname Depart　－

＊Kaname＊＠１１９＿０１４I really learned so much￥since coming here.＝＠１１９＿０１５I think these days here were￥worth as much as the whole life￥ahead of us.＝＠１１９＿０１６There were hard times, but￥really...￥I'm glad I qualified.＝＠１１９＿０１７Otherwise I wouldn't be standing￥here beside you right now!
＊Kaname＊＠１１９＿０２５I'm so happy right now, I almost￥feel bad for everyone else!＝＠１１９＿０２６Thank you... thank you so much￥for choosing me!＝＠１１９＿０２７From here on... let's give it￥our all, together!
